title: Two glazed openings in an exposed building face and proposed fire shutters (Council Order 0015470)
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the order

facts.text: The appeal concerned two glazed openings in a home’s exposed building face and whether interior fire shutters could provide the required closure protection.
A second question was whether Protektor board under vinyl siding could be accepted as equivalent to gypsum board for the wall assembly.
facts.locator: PDF p.2, issue para 2; p.1, order text

facts.text: The order required either removing the openings or providing an acceptable alternative solution; for the wall it required gypsum board or adequate information for consideration of Protektor board.
